_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Conversations with the message_user tool show the chat: the user's messages, the agent's message_user messages with their reply quotes and attachments, and its reactions; "See All" shows everything and sticks for such conversations, other conversations keep their own setting. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} has message_user on and runs in a directory holding chart.png (a 40x30 PNG) and report.txt ("the report"). The user asked "Please check the build" (the predictable model's own text reply to it begins "edit predictable.go"); the agent then called message_user three times: "Looking now." replying to that message with the reaction 👀; "Here are the results." with the attachments chart.png and report.txt; and a refused call replying to a message that does not exist (its failure reads "message_user failed"). Call "fork" forks the conversation as /c/message-user-fork and has the agent react 🍴 there to the copy of the first message, through message_user. /c/{{PLAIN}} is an ordinary conversation ("Hello"). "The bubbles" are the elements with data-testid "message-user-bubble". "The chat area" is ".messages-container" (not the page: the drawer previews other conversations); "the chat area's text T" is the element inside it holding T (selector "*" with has_text T, "within" ".messages-container"). "The asked message" is the first element with data-testid "message" whose text contains "Please check the build". "Open the view options" means: click ".chat-overflow-menu-wrapper .btn-icon"; "the view options" is the element with data-testid "conversation-view-toggle", and its buttons are picked by role "button" and name (with "within" it). 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. There should be exactly 2 bubbles. 3. The "[data-testid=\"message-user-text\"]" elements inside the bubbles should read, in order, exactly ["Looking now.", "Here are the results."] (assert_texts). 4. The chat area must hold exactly 0 elements with the text "edit predictable.go" and exactly 0 with the text "message_user failed": the agent's own text and the refused call stay out of the chat. 5. The asked message's element with data-testid "message-reactions" should read exactly "👀". 6. The image attachment previews: eval (() => { const b = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message-user-bubble"]'); const img = b[b.length - 1].querySelector('.message-user-image img'); return img ? img.naturalWidth : -1; })() until it returns exactly "40". 7. The bubble containing "Here are the results." has an element with data-testid "message-user-file" that should contain "report.txt". 8. That file link downloads the file: eval (async () => { const b = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message-user-bubble"]'); const a = b[b.length - 1].querySelector('[data-testid="message-user-file"]'); const r = await fetch(a.getAttribute('href')); return r.ok + ' ' + await r.text(); })(), which must return exactly "true the report". 9. Under reduced motion the highlight animation ends at once and takes its class along, so watch for the class: in one eval without "expect", on the asked message element, start a MutationObserver on its class attribute that sets el.dataset.highlighted = "1" whenever el.classList contains "message-highlight". 10. Click the element with data-testid "message-user-quote" in the bubble containing "Looking now.". 11. The asked message should get the attribute data-highlighted exactly "1": the quote jumps to the message it replies to. 12. Open the view options. 13. The view options' button named "See Chat Only" should have aria-pressed exactly "true". 14. The view options must hold exactly 0 buttons named "See End of Turn Messages Only". 15. Click the view options' button named "See All". 16. It should have aria-pressed exactly "true". 17. Press "Escape". 18. The chat area's text "message_user failed" should be visible, and so should its text "edit predictable.go". 19. There should still be exactly 2 bubbles. 20. Reload. 21. The chat area's text "message_user failed" should be visible: See All stuck. 22. Call "fork"; it returns "forked". 23. Navigate to /c/message-user-fork. A fork copies the messages with new IDs: reactions and quotes still find their targets, and new calls target the fork's copies. 24. Eval (() => { const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message"]')].find((el) => el.textContent.includes('Please check the build')); const r = m && m.querySelector('[data-testid="message-reactions"]'); return !!r && /👀.*🍴/s.test(r.textContent); })() until it returns true. 25. The first element with data-testid "message-user-quote" should be enabled. 26. Navigate to /c/{{PLAIN}}. 27. Open the view options. 28. The view options' button named "See All" should have aria-pressed exactly "true". 29. The view options must hold exactly 0 buttons named "See Chat Only".

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message-user-bubble"]'); const img = b[b.length - 1].querySelector('.message-user-image img'); return img ? img.naturalWidth : -1; })()

(async () => { const b = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message-user-bubble"]'); const a = b[b.length - 1].querySelector('[data-testid="message-user-file"]'); const r = await fetch(a.getAttribute('href')); return r.ok + ' ' + await r.text(); })()

(() => { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message"]')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('Please check the build')); const obs = new MutationObserver(() => { if (el.classList.contains('message-highlight')) el.dataset.highlighted = '1'; }); obs.observe(el, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class'] }); return 'ok'; })()
